contract: V8-B0 formal complete whole-hand flat-color geometry contract

scope.nextImplementationGateAfterApproval: V8-B1 formal complete whole-hand flat-color geometry

H1.name: locked visible whole-hand ownership
H1.topologyRule: preserve approved visible hand outline and finger gaps

H2.name: frozen minimum hidden wrist-root envelope
H2.registration: hidden whole-hand material responsibility behind the approved forearm-above-hand draw order

H3.name: additional inverse-coverage hidden wrist root
H3.definition: minimal additional hand-local pixels required by the approved wrist-angle domain after H1 and H2 are fixed
H3.pixels: to be solved in V8-B1 after V8-B0 approval
H3.allowedRegion: wrist-root neighborhood only; must not expand into palm, fingers, fingertips, or finger-gap topology
H3.constructionMethod: inverse coverage from target wrist skin-responsibility pixels at sampled wrist angles, followed by constrained minimization
notAllowedConstruction: direct union of all transformed whole-hand silhouettes
morphological closing that fills finger gaps

H4.name: bidirectional wrist coverage QA responsibility
H4.definition: QA-only set used to measure wrist seam coverage with forearm skin and whole-hand skin

partitions.formalMaterialEquationAfterApproval: M_hand = H1 union H2 union H3
partitionInvariants: H1, H2, and H3 responsibilities are mutually exclusive in the contract ledger
visible ownership remains unique even where complete materials overlap while hidden
H4 is excluded from material pixel counts

inverseCoverageSamplingContract.parameterAuthority: reuse V7-C1 frozen wrist parameter domain and V4/V7 arm-chain FK until explicitly reopened
targetCoverage: wrist skin responsibility with bracelet hidden
wrist skin responsibility with approved forearm above hand
inverseCoverageProcedure: For each approved wrist sample, compute target wrist skin-responsibility pixels not covered by locked visible ownership.
Hide bracelet contribution before accepting a wrist seam as skin-covered.
Inverse-transform each missing target pixel into frozen hand-local coordinates.
Seed H3 only from inverse-mapped pixels that are required by at least one legal sample.
Apply locality and topology constraints, then recompute the entire sampled domain.
Iterate until no coverage failure remains and no removable H3 pixel can be deleted without creating a sampled-domain failure.
inverseCoverageSamplingContract.minimalityClaimAllowed: sample-domain minimal after deletion proof and adaptive boundary search
inverseCoverageSamplingContract.minimalityClaimNotAllowed: global continuous-domain optimum unless separately proven
adaptiveDensificationTriggers: any forearm/hand visible intersection outside approved hidden overlap
any prototype triangle flip in downstream QA proxy
any contour collision, wedge spike, or blob-like wrist-root artifact
adaptiveStopConditions: all triggered intervals have been bisected until adjacent samples produce the same pass classification or the remaining interval is below the declared wrist-parameter tolerance
the final H3 deletion audit finds no pixel whose removal preserves all sampled coverage and topology checks
deterministic regeneration has zero file differences

requiredForV8B1: V_hand visible ownership intersections with sleeve, upper_arm, forearm, and bracelet are all 0
H3 is restricted to the approved wrist-root region
default recomposition source-coordinate difference is 0 for locked visible pixels
requiredForV8C: rerun wrist 201 dense samples with real M_hand
rerun 11 boundary-neighborhood samples with real M_hand
rerun 81 adaptive wrist samples with real M_hand
rerun elbow-by-wrist 9x9 combination domain with real M_hand
rerun part-detachment, bone-length, transparent-gap, contour-collision, and prototype-triangle-flip checks
stageAClosureAuditMustList: all unchanged upstream freeze manifests and user approval records
H2 81 px hidden responsibility overlaid by visible forearm/bracelet ownership
bracelet not counted as wrist skin coverage
forearm including bracelet remains above whole hand
formal hand material still flat-color geometry, not texture

mustJudge: hand shape remains the approved V8-A hand
finger gaps remain transparent and natural
wrist root does not become a round blob, thick wrist, or wedge spike
no flashing seam, hole, detachment, or visible puncture appears through the wrist domain
bracelet reads as forearm-owned decoration, not skin coverage

reopenRules: If M_hand cannot contain all 389 envelope pixels, V7 wrist conclusions lapse and the current wrist contract must reopen.
If H3 cannot satisfy bracelet-hidden wrist skin coverage without visible blob/spike artifacts, the contract must stop before V8-B1 freeze.

If the approved draw order cannot support the sampled wrist domain, identify the concrete counterexample and the frozen contracts to reopen before proposing clipping, a local reverse draw order, or an independent wrist layer.
If future action evidence requires finger pixels to move relative to palm pixels, material granularity must reopen before finger splitting.
If any source coordinate, source RGB, visible ownership, wrist point, local coordinate, draw order, or bracelet ownership lock changes, V8-B0 is invalid.
nextInstructionAfterUserApproval: Generate V8-B1 formal complete whole-hand flat-color geometry from H1, H2, and inverse-coverage-minimized H3; do not generate texture, PSD, Cubism, Physics, or Runtime.
